description: Linear aesthetic head over an image embedding. Explicitly a PRIOR: the ranking engine reweights it per user from PrefEvents, so it must never be treated as ground truth.

normalisation.calibration_note: Head emits a 1-10 rating. Rescaled linearly to [0,1] for the contract's Unit; raw_value is retained on the Score so a recalibration needs no re-run.

notes:
Consumes an embedding, not pixels, so it is nearly free once SigLIP has run -- which is why the pipeline orders embedding before aesthetic. The original head was trained on CLIP ViT-L/14 features; running it on SigLIP 2 features requires retraining the linear head, and until that is done this entry is a placeholder for the shape of the config rather than a working model.

BATCHING (issue #31): DEMOTED TO 1, UNVERIFIED. This entry declared supported=true, max_batch=256, dynamic_axes=true. weights.blake3 is null, so the ONNX graph it names has never been produced or hashed, let alone had its input shape read -- the claim was an assumption wearing the clothes of a measurement, which is the same defect issue #31 found in the YuNet entry. Restore it by running onnxruntime.InferenceSession(...).get_inputs()[0].shape against the pinned checkpoint and recording that in batching.verified_against. Declining to batch costs throughput and nothing else.
